message: The C# language version '{0}' is not supported. Change the <{1}> property of your project file to one of the following supported values: {2}. Do not use 'latest' or 'latestMajor' because these values are interpreted inconsistently when you use a .NET SDK or IDE that is more recent than Metalama.
rationale: 'latestMajor' is quoted with backticks instead of single quotes like 'latest', and 'it will be inconsistently interpreted' uses a singular pronoun for two values and an awkward comparison ('a more recent .NET SDK or IDE than Metalama').
